Job Overview:

We are looking for a detail-oriented Junior Accountant with 1-2 years of experience to support day-to-day accounting operations. The candidate will be responsible for maintaining accurate financial records, assisting in compliance work, and ensuring smooth processing of transactions.

* Pass accounting entries in Tally (Sales, Purchase, Receipt, Payment, Journal)

* Assist in GST-related work (data preparation, reconciliation, basic return support)

* Prepare and verify invoices, e-invoice, e-way bills, and billing documentation

* Monitor receivables and payables, follow up if required

* Maintain proper documentation and filing of financial records

* Assist senior accountants in finalization and audit support work

Skills Required

* Strong understanding of basic accounting concepts

* Hands-on experience in Tally (Prime/ERP 9)

* Working knowledge of MS Excel (basic formulas, data handling)

* Basic knowledge of GST and taxation

* Good numerical and analytical skills

* Attention to detail and accuracy in data entry

* Ability to meet deadlines and manage routine accounting tasks

Preferred

* 1-2 years of Experience in billing, e-invoicing, or accounting related work

* Exposure to GST, TDS, TCS and other compliances

Pay: ₹15,000.00 - ₹18,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

jobs_results.title: Junior Accountant
jobs_results.description:
We are seeking a detail-oriented Junior Accountant to join our finance team in the Delhi-NCR region. The ideal candidate will be responsible for managing financial records, ensuring accuracy in bookkeeping, and assisting with bank reconciliations. This role is crucial for maintaining the integrity of our financial data and supporting the overall financial health of the organization.

Key Responsibilities:
- Perform daily bookkeeping tasks, including recording financial transactions and maintaining accurate ledgers.
- Assist in preparing financial statements and reports to provide insights into the company's financial performance.
- Conduct bank reconciliations to ensure that all transactions are accurately reflected in our financial records.
- Support the preparation and filing of GST returns, ensuring compliance with tax regulations.
- Collaborate with other team members to streamline accounting processes and improve efficiency.
- Maintain organized financial records and documentation for audits and reviews.

Required Skills:
- Proficiency in Tally and other accounting software.
- Strong understanding of general accounting principles and practices.
- Experience with bank reconciliation processes.
- Knowledge of GST regulations and compliance.
- Excellent attention to detail and organizational skills.
- Ability to work independently and as part of a team.

If you are a motivated individual with a passion for accounting and finance, we encourage you to apply for this exciting opportunity to grow your career as a Junior Accountant.
